limitations: Vector arithmetic is type-checked; no machine code is generated by Toucan.
Native execution proves the pointer FFI representation and C/Rust callbacks, not execution of the retained expression graph.
The fixed-input retained replay had no sanitizer instrumentation and is not a sustained fuzz campaign.
Vectors larger than16 bytes need explicit compiler/CPU-feature configuration.
Static vector expressions other than vector compound literals require an unsupported lane constant evaluator.
Mixed vector element-type conversions, enum vectors, ext_vector_type/swizzles, and architecture intrinsics remain unsupported.
Windows aligned(1) vector typedefs keep natural field alignment; bindings reject this mismatch.
